explanation: Ile-Ife is sacred to the Yoruba as the place where the world was created. Its finest heads date from about the 12th to the 15th centuries.

claims.text: The naturalistic copper-alloy heads of Ife were made by ancestors of the Yoruba people.

In Yoruba tradition, Ile-Ife is the place where the world was created.
Ife's naturalistic copper-alloy and terracotta heads date mainly from about the 12th to the 15th centuries.
